takeaway: A Java 23 Swing desktop client, with Hibernate, the MySQL JDBC driver and persistence.xml on its classpath, runs on the user's workstation and talks JDBC over TCP 3306 to a MySQL server (default 127.0.0.1, schema reports_db).
